name: rl-restore

caCertBootstrap.note: vendored in containers/restore/vendor and dpkg-installed before any apt traffic (the base image ships no CA bundle)

notes: Node and its libraries come from the digest-pinned base image. apt packages are installed at exact versions from a frozen Debian snapshot; a version drift fails the build. Resolved strings are baked into the image (harness-*-version files) and re-verified by the worker.
